rust_summary: opening a portable crafting table on Host (`open_workbench`).
doc_summary: `Host::open_workbench(uuid)` opens a crafting table menu without a table block (Bukkit `openWorkbench(null, true)`, Essentials `/workbench`); it crafts as a table does and gives its grid back when closed. Bundles need "hooks": @API:host_open_workbench@.
